summary: Research arms (#1185): eight CCG-strategy changes as switches on the Contender (BotContext.Contender(...), all off by default; champion unchanged), with a pre-registered two-stage test. Stage 1 screening chose one switch (veto-only attack estimate, +5); the integrated arm contender2 is the Contender plus it. Arms rec1-discard2, rec2a/2b, rec3, rec4, rec5, rec7, rec8 and contender2 are in BotTournament; docs/bots/research/ holds the compiled CCG advice, docs/bots/experiments/2026-11-08-research-arms.md the plan and result.
validation: AI planner tests (12) pass, one per testable switch; repo format check passes. Stage 1 (10 runs, 364 games each, block 3000): no soundness findings. Stage 2 final arena (1,456 games per arm, block 5000): contender2 against the champion gained 125, lost 189 (net -64, p=0.0004); the Contender -58 (p=0.001); contender2 vs Contender -6 (p=0.51); 0 stalls/illegal/exceptions; 6-7 games out of time per arm. Outcome negative per the pre-registered rule.
remaining: NEGATIVE: no research switch beat the champion; the Contender itself loses about four points of win rate (the earlier neutral reading was underpowered). Flags stay off; nothing promoted. Next: find why the purchase slate and triage lose games; rec4 presence denial never triggers (untested); check.sh not run; the PR is open for review, not merged.
